reason: I might take the free call and look at the 15 companies, since that costs nothing. But I would not sign the pilot this month. My partner would ask why we pay an agency EUR 300 a meeting when Apollo and a junior SDR could build this in-house, and one logistics case study is not enough to answer that.
objection: EUR 1,800 for a 45-day test plus EUR 300 per meeting after that adds up fast for a wholesaler our size. I have only one proof point and it comes from logistics, not wholesale. I am not sure an outside firm can talk to my kind of buyers in their language better than my own person could.
would_change_my_mind: If the free list of 15 companies came back with names I already wanted but could not reach, and I could speak to a wholesale or distribution client who got real orders from the meetings, I could take that to my partner and sign the pilot.
